title: Carnot COP limit
references: Cengel, Y. A. and Boles, M. A., Thermodynamics: An Engineering Approach, 9th ed., McGraw-Hill Education (2019)
Callen, H. B., Thermodynamics and an Introduction to Thermostatistics, 2nd ed., Wiley (1985)
validity_domain: Heat pump or refrigerator exchanging heat with two reservoirs at constant absolute temperatures Th > Tc > 0.
limitations: Applies to a device exchanging heat with two reservoirs only
Reached only by a reversible cycle, so a theoretical bound that real devices do not reach

variables.Th: Absolute temperature of the hot reservoir
variables.Tc: Absolute temperature of the cold reservoir
